name: SockLock
description: SockLock sells magnetic socks that do not get lost in the washing machine. A small magnet on the cuffs keeps each pair together.
audience: US adults who do their own laundry and are tired of odd, mismatched or missing socks.
voice: Friendly, plain words, a little dry humor, no hype, no exclamation-mark overload.
facts: Magnetic socks: a small magnet on the cuffs keeps each pair together.
Pairs do not get lost in the washing machine.
Subscription: five pairs for $29, then a new shipment once a quarter.
